title: Supreme Court warns against politicising Ram Mandir fund theft case, says it is only a case of commission of crime
description: The Supreme Court on Monday cautioned against politicising  the Ayodhya Ram Mandir funds embezzlement case.A Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana was hearing a batch of public interest litigation (PIL) petitions seeking a probe by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) into the alleged embezzlement of funds meant for the construction of the Ayodhya Ram Mandir."Just a word of caution ... Don't politicise the issue. Courts are not a place
